uncertainty.estimand: paired mean per-engine cost difference, risk minus sensor, for fixed fitted policies and observed replay outcomes
uncertainty.limitation: Resamples observed engine outcomes, not capacity-coupled fleet replays. Descriptive conditional uncertainty only; no coverage guarantee under capacity interference. Excludes refitting uncertainty.

contract: Persistent request queue; eligible after lead time, frozen request priority. Failures join shared repair queue next period if enabled. Repairs occupy bays including service period. Common horizon is latest natural failure across all engines and arrivals, identical across policies within a scenario. Repair work beyond horizon is censored. Frozen baseline policies are stress-tested, not retuned.
